source.name: OTTO Recommender Systems Dataset, training file
source.grain: one anonymized session with timestamped click, cart, and order events

checks: all 12,899,779 sessions and 216,716,096 events in the pinned training file were parsed
a 2-day validation horizon was created from the latest training timestamps using seed 42
189,024 training sessions with fewer than two pre-cutoff events were excluded, matching OTTO's split helper
644 holdout sessions were removed after filtering unknown items or sessions shorter than two events
item popularity counts use only sessions and events before the temporal cutoff
validation predictions use only the visible prefix of each session
click ground truth is the next click; cart and order ground truth are distinct future item IDs
Recall@20 uses pooled hits and denominators with official 0.10, 0.30, and 0.60 action weights

evidenceBoundary: Offline ranking metrics on a historical public release do not measure impressions, assignment, CTR or purchase lift, revenue, margin, or current OTTO production performance.
